newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi lifts Asia Sept Super Light formula 10 cts.
newsitem.headline: Saudi lifts Asia Sept Super Light formula 10 cts.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has decided to raise its Arab Super Light September-lifting crude oil price formula to Asia by 10 cents per barrel, traders said on Tuesday.
The September Arab Super Light formula was set at the Oman/Dubai average plus $1.30, up from last month's Oman/Dubai average plus $1.20, traders said.
Saudi Arabia has also said it has decided to raise its September-lifting crude oil price formula to Asian customers by 10 cents per barrel for both Arab Light and Berri Extra Light, traders said.
It has also told its Asian customers it is raising its September-lifting crude oil price formula for Arab Medium and Arab Heavy by 20 cents per barrel, they said.
The September term crude price for Arab Light was set at the Oman/Dubai average plus 10 cents per barrel.
Berri Extra Light was set at the Oman/Dubai average plus 65 cents per barrel, up 10 cents per barrel from August.

The formula for Arab Medium was lifted to the Oman/Dubai average minus 30 cents per barrel, up 20 cents per barrel from August, while Arab Heavy was lifted to Oman/Dubai minus $1.00, also up 20 cents ber barrel from August.
